purpose: Reduce v9.7 upstream time loss by letting exact episode raycast memory own handoff and coarse routing while rejecting visual-only contact ownership

diagnostics.finding: The successful episode used raycast ownership and no exact rescan. All four failures used one or more visual handoffs; five fixed 40-step exact scans failed in total. Exact log coordinates were nevertheless present in episode memory.

iteration_results.name: current-raycast-only handoff
iteration_results.decision: insufficient; it prevented false contact but left scan-verified coordinates unused after the crosshair moved

iteration_results.name: reachable raycast-memory handoff
iteration_results.decision: insufficient; three failure targets remained beyond the unchanged 14-block contact boundary

iteration_results.name: exact raycast-memory coarse route plus bounded handoff
iteration_results.decision: retained as experimental because it rescued two stable failures, but promotion stopped because targeted smoke remained below a defensible teacher gate

teacher_gate.reason: The final targeted smoke was only 2/5. Running the formal 20 episodes would consume fresh seeds without adequate promotion evidence.

remaining_failure_model.17509: the only exact log observation arrived near the episode end, so neither exact routing nor contact could begin in time
remaining_failure_model.17511: exact routing reached real contact, but coordinate approach/recovery and target switching consumed the remaining episode
remaining_failure_model.17513: a log was broken at step 67, but 72-step drop recovery failed around an elevated tree and later target attempts exhausted the episode

decision.next_direction: separate exact-target discovery coverage from coordinate-contact convergence and elevated drop recovery; do not tune the BC gate yet
